verdict.rationale: Inngest explicitly supports deploying functions/workers to your own infrastructure while syncing with either the Inngest cloud platform or a self-hosted server, matching the 'workers in own infra, vendor manages orchestration' model (inngest-gh-1, inngest-docs-9). However, evidence doesn't detail network isolation guarantees, air-gapped connectivity, or how much execution data/payloads transit through the vendor's control plane versus staying local, and self-hosting the control plane itself is offered as an alternative (blurring the 'vendor manages control plane' framing) rather than a documented hybrid architecture. missing for 10: explicit architecture diagram/doc describing what data crosses the network boundary to the hosted control plane, independent confirmation of data locality/isolation claims, and clarity on whether self-hosting the control plane is required to fully keep data in-network.
